question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Walk on air
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'to be extremely happy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given idiom **'Walk on air'** (हवा में चलना) means to feel extremely happy or elated.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is-** 'To be extremely happy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To describe an unusual situation** (असामान्य स्थिति का वर्णन करना) - Not related to the given idiom.
 
• **Feeling weakened or tired** (कमजोर या थका हुआ महसूस करना) - Not related to the given idiom.
 
• **To work hard **(कड़ी मेहनत करना) - Not related to the given idiom
